mods.name: mem0-per-agent-scoping
mods.description: mem0 provider honors a per-call agent_id and does two-scope recall — a specialist reads its own private lessons layered on the shared base, while the primary agent is unchanged. Foundation of per-specialist memory.
mods.impact_if_dropped: Per-agent/specialist memory stops working: every agent collapses to one shared 'hermes' scope with no private lessons.

mods.name: specialist-mem-gate-agentinit
mods.description: init_agent: provider_memory/memory_agent_id/memory_read_only params + split memory gate so a specialist gets scoped mem0 retrieval without loading MEMORY.md.
mods.impact_if_dropped: Specialist subagents lose scoped memory + read-only writes; the delegation memory gate breaks.

mods.name: specialist-mem-readonly-runagent
mods.description: run_agent: thread the 3 memory params + gate the per-turn sync_all write behind _memory_read_only (keeps retrieval, drops append-all).
mods.impact_if_dropped: Specialist subagents resume uncurated append-all memory writes instead of read-only recall.

mods.name: specialist-binding-delegate
mods.description: delegate_tool: bind a specialist to a child — inject its playbook (standing rules), scope its mem0 agent_id (read-only), and pass its tool allowlist.
mods.impact_if_dropped: Delegated subagents can't run as specialists (no playbook, no scoped memory, no tool allowlist).

mods.name: langfuse-observability-fixes
mods.description: Langfuse plugin: (1) drop the two deprecated set_trace_io() calls (trace I/O is derived from the as_root root observation on Langfuse 3.205.0); (2) _serialize_assistant_message reads reasoning via _extract_reasoning() so GLM(Z.AI)/DeepSeek/Kimi chain-of-thought (returned in reasoning_content, not reasoning) is captured instead of logged as null.
mods.impact_if_dropped: The set_trace_io DeprecationWarning returns and GLM/DeepSeek/Kimi reasoning is logged as reasoning:null in every trace.

mods.name: session-model-api-server
mods.description: api_server honors the per-session stored model on session chat turns (upstream always ran the config.yaml default — Nexus per-task models were cosmetic) + accepts an optional per-turn body 'model' override on /api/sessions/{id}/chat[/stream] (JARVIS peak-overload fallback runs ONE turn on dispatch.fallback_model in the SAME session).
mods.impact_if_dropped: Every api_server session turn silently runs the config.yaml default model again: per-task models (glm-5.1/glm-4.5-air pools), the dispatch overload fallback and the JARVIS glm-5-turbo fallback all stop switching models.

mods.name: zai-prompt-fingerprint
mods.description: Rewords HERMES_AGENT_HELP_GUIDANCE: Z.AI's coding endpoint 429-blocks (code 1305, disguised as 'temporarily overloaded') every glm-5.2 request whose system prompt contains the upstream phrase 'You run on Hermes Agent' — verified 2026-07-10 by replaying the gateway's dumped request and bisecting the prompt to that exact sentence. glm-5-turbo is not filtered, which is why only the fallback answered.
mods.impact_if_dropped: Every glm-5.2 turn through Hermes (JARVIS, CLI, agent lanes) gets 429 code 1305 again and JARVIS permanently falls back to glm-5-turbo while direct API calls work — looks exactly like a provider overload.
